name: chatgpt-web-bridge
description: A local-first Codex/OpenCode toolkit series: visible Web LLM bridge workers, durable interruption recovery, automatic task-output ZIP handoff, browser watchdog health events, and fail-closed multi-web-session swarms.

interface.shortDescription: Run isolated Codex↔web-AI links with safe recovery and automatic task-file handoff.
interface.longDescription: Codex Bridge Toolkit Series contains the visible Web LLM Conversation Bridge, parallel Codex and OpenCode host adapters, isolated MCP workers for independent host conversations, a read-only Edge/Chrome browser watchdog with durable health events, human-readable multi-link status, a read-only GitHub workspace binder, generic MCP host compatibility reporting, safe local artifact context, and an experimental fail-closed Web Session Swarm. A swarm coordinates multiple explicitly selected visible web conversations, gives each member its own worker, browser target, and watchdog, and shares only a compact read-only local Git workspace summary. OpenCode can use the toolkit as a local stdio MCP server or expose the documented opencode serve HTTP API for managed execution. Users explicitly select bounded Markdown/text/CSV reads; Word/PPT/PDF remain metadata-only until content adapters are added. The bridge verifies the destination before every send and never auto-replaces tabs or resends uncertain prompts. The GitHub toolkit never pulls, pushes, commits, or contacts GitHub automatically. Computer Use, DevSpace-specific behavior, Notion API, and Word/PPT content adapters are not claimed by this release. No passwords, cookies, API keys, private endpoints, or hidden chain-of-thought are collected.
